observations.body: The sage says human speech cannot finish naming God, whose works exceed praise and whose greatness is beyond tracing.
observations.label: Praise reaches the limit of speech: action

observations.body: The readers are urged to exalt God while admitting that their language falls short.
observations.label: Praise reaches the limit of speech: response

observations.body: end of the matter · beyond all his works · who has seen him?
observations.label: Words in Sirach 43:27–33

payload.posture: Read Sirach 43:27–33 as judgment, exile, and the nations evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Saying God exceeds speech does not make every statement about God equally true or useless.
payload.title: Praise reaches the limit of speech
